# codebase-graph-mcp

> MCP server that builds a dependency graph of your codebase, enabling AI coding assistants to understand project structure and make safer changes.

## What it does

Scans source files (Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust), parses import/export statements, and builds an in-memory dependency graph. Exposes 12 tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that any compatible AI assistant (Claude Code, Hermes Agent, etc.) can call.

## Tools (12)

### Dependency Analysis
- `get_dependencies` — files that a given file imports
- `get_dependents` — files that import a given file
- `impact_analysis` — recursive BFS of what breaks if you change a file
- `multi_file_impact` — combined impact of multiple files, accepts git diff ref
- `project_overview` — file counts, most imported files, entry points, orphans
- `refresh_graph` — force re-scan after file changes

### Architecture
- `detect_cycles` — circular dependency detection (Tarjan's SCC)
- `package_dependencies` — package-level dependency view with configurable depth
- `class_hierarchy` — Python class inheritance, methods, subclass overrides
- `visualize_graph` — generates interactive HTML graph (vis.js), opens in browser

### Git History
- `file_churn` — most frequently changed files (hotspot detection)
- `co_change` — files that frequently change together (hidden coupling)

## Supported Languages

- Python (.py): absolute/relative imports, submodule imports, TYPE_CHECKING imports tracked as type-only
- TypeScript / JavaScript (.ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs): multi-line and `import type` forms, tsconfig/jsconfig `paths` aliases
- Rust (.rs) with Cargo.toml workspace parsing
- Config files (.json, .json5 under config/) in the OpenMind OM1 layout only

Type-only imports and Rust `mod` declarations never count as circular dependencies. File lists come from `git ls-files` inside a repository, so `.gitignore` is honoured. File arguments must stay inside the project root.

## Installation

### 1. Build from source (required)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/0xbyt4/codebase-graph-mcp.git
cd codebase-graph-mcp
npm install
npm run build
```

### 2. Connect to your AI assistant

#### Claude Code
```bash
claude mcp add -s user codebase-graph -- node /path/to/codebase-graph-mcp/build/index.js
```

#### Hermes Agent (config.yaml)
```yaml
mcp_servers:
  codebase-graph:
    command: "node"
    args: ["/path/to/codebase-graph-mcp/build/index.js"]
    env: {}
```

## Configuration

All tools accept an optional `project_root` parameter. Resolution order:
1. `project_root` parameter in tool call
2. `PROJECT_ROOT` environment variable
3. Current working directory

## Key Parameters

### visualize_graph
- `top` (number, default 40) — number of top most-imported files to include
- `scope` (string) — directory filter applied before ranking (e.g. "gateway", "src/agent")
- `output` (string) — output HTML file path, inside the project root
- `open_browser` (boolean, default true) — open the file with the system browser
- `project_root` (string) — absolute path to project root

### multi_file_impact
- `files` (string[]) — list of changed file paths
- `diff_ref` (string) — git ref to diff against (e.g. "main", "HEAD~3")

### package_dependencies
- `depth` (number, default 2) — directory depth for package grouping
- `package_name` (string) — filter to specific package

### class_hierarchy
- `class_name` (string) — look up a specific class
- `file` (string) — get all classes in a file
- `method_name` (string) — find all classes that define/override a method

### file_churn / co_change
- `days` (number, default 90) — git history period to analyze

## Architecture

```
src/
  index.ts           — MCP server + 12 tool definitions
  parser.ts          — regex-based import parser (TS/JS + Python + Rust)
  graph.ts           — dependency graph engine + cycle detection + package analysis
  class-analyzer.ts  — Python class hierarchy extraction
  config-parser.ts   — config file module reference parser
  cargo-parser.ts    — Cargo.toml workspace cross-crate dependency parser
  git-history.ts     — git log analysis (churn + co-change)
```

## Design

- Zero runtime dependencies beyond MCP SDK
- Regex-based parsing (no AST parsers, no native binaries)
- Works offline (no API calls)
- Multi-project support (cache per project root)
- Graph cached in memory, refresh with `refresh_graph`
